title: Rust: HTTP Server (Simulated)
description: Simulate an HTTP server with route matching and response handling.

steps.title: HTTP Request Parser
steps.description: Write a function `parse_http_request(raw: &str) -> (String, String, HashMap<String, String>)` that extracts method, path, and headers from a raw HTTP request string like `"GET /api/users HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\n"`.

verification.failureMessage: Parse and print method and path from a raw request.

steps.title: Route Matcher
steps.description: Create a `Router` struct with a `HashMap<String, HashMap<String, Box<dyn Fn(&Request) -> Response>>>` (method → path → handler). Add a `GET /hello` route that returns a greeting. Test route matching.

verification.failureMessage: Match GET /hello and print the response.

steps.title: Route Parameters
steps.description: Add support for path parameters like `/users/:id`. Parse the parameter and pass it to the handler. Test with `GET /users/42` printing `"User 42"`.
hints: Split both pattern and request path by `/`.
Match segment by segment, collect `:param` values.

steps.title: JSON Response
steps.description: Create a helper `json_response(body: &str, status: u16) -> String` that returns a properly formatted HTTP response with Content-Type: application/json. Test with a JSON body.
hints: Wrap body in the HTTP response format.

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a JSON HTTP response.

steps.title: Full Router Demo
steps.description: Wire everything together: create a router with routes for GET / (home), GET /hello (greeting), GET /users/:id (user detail). Parse a request, match the route, and print the response.
hints:
Create a sample request: `"GET /users/42 HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost

"`
Parse, route, handle, and print the response.

verification.failureMessage: Route and handle a GET /users/42 request.
